name: sakura-legacy
description: Sakura — the single-file HTML outliner app (index.html/hub.html), part of the sakura-monorepo npm workspace (see root package.json and docs/history/web-migration/framework-migration-plan.md). Moved into legacy/ from the repo root during Phase 0 of the React migration; this package is otherwise unchanged — .github/workflows/deploy.yml builds legacy/dist/ (via `npm run build -w sakura-legacy`) and publishes it via actions/deploy-pages on every push to main, same as before the move.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
